name: annotation version: the page is not recognised
why: The pageType's match never answers: no button.

name: annotation version: the fetched page is not converted
why: The converter runs on the live page only. A non_paginated page is read from the live document, so the fetched-copy hook is not reached today; it is kept for parity with the other converters (a guard the spec cannot see, recorded).

name: annotation version: an old version is taken for the current one
why: The current version is always this one: every block compares equal.

name: annotation version: changed blocks are never paired
why: Between equal blocks, nothing is paired: a rewrite reads as removed + added.

name: annotation version: a paragraph keeps the section of the version it came from
why: The section follows this version's heading first: an added paragraph lands in the wrong section.

name: annotation version: a changed row has no card
why: The Status cell gets no comparison.

name: annotation version: equal blocks are not recognised
why: The LCS key adds the kind twice for paragraphs: no block is ever equal.

name: annotation version: the card on the td, not inside it
why: The status and its card are written on the <td>: a disk file keeps only listed td attributes, the card is lost.

edits.find: return [String(k + 1), r.section, lines(r.a, r.heading), lines(r.b, r.heading), [st]];
